original_test_intent: Enumerate every platform memory slot and verify each populated or empty state and reported module information against the approved topology.
original_method: On the approved Linux host, securely run corrected `dmidecode -t memory`, preserve all Memory Device records and raw checksum, map locators/handles and fields to the expected slot topology, and corroborate with NUMA/topology without changing state.
manual_activity: User supplies the approved slot topology/specification and host/access; agent can perform the complete read-only collection.
required_inputs: Approved Linux host identity and secure privileged access
Expected physical slot count, locator map and module specification
Protected evidence storage and hardware-identifier handling policy
safety_requirements: Verify exact host before privileged read
Use least privilege, managed authentication and host verification
Protect module serial/part identifiers and preserve complete raw output
Stop on wrong host, privilege failure, malformed SMBIOS or instability
No DIMM/BIOS change, reboot or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type17 records including empty slots with checksum/status
Map handle/locator/bank and module fields to expected topology and corroborate NUMA
Do not filter records, alter hardware, fabricate absent fields or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide authoritative slot topology and module specification

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The corrected DMI command is relevant, but unsafe SSH and filtering to installed devices violate complete all-slot coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely run unfiltered `dmidecode -t memory`, capture version, exit status, complete raw output/checksum and optional NUMA corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Memory Slot, every-slot correctness, Linux/dmidecode and1/1 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture all Type17 records atomically and compare every locator, including empty slots, with the signed platform map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects the command typo and adds secure access, complete evidence, checksums and explicit failure boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None; installed-only filtering would regress the explicit all-slot requirement and is rejected.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS locator names can be vendor-specific or incomplete and do not by themselves prove a physical label without the platform map.

project_override_considerations: Project may define vendor locator aliases, but every expected slot must map explicitly and missing/unknown entries remain visible.
expected_evidence: Host/date, OS/kernel, board/BIOS/SMBIOS and dmidecode version
Complete raw Type17 output, checksum and command status
Every handle/locator/bank including populated and empty slots
Expected-versus-observed slot map plus optional NUMA corroboration
Secure audit, health logs and final unchanged state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The intent and criteria consistently require all-slot inventory. The missing command hyphen is an unambiguous executable typo corrected in the Review layer.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Host access, privilege, dmidecode and topology can be supplied; the read-only inspection is automatable.

review_improvement: Corrects the literal command and prevents installed-only filtering from hiding empty or missing slots.
independent_technical_reasoning: Each SMBIOS Type17 structure represents a memory device slot whether populated or not. Filtering on nonzero Size removes the very absence evidence needed to prove complete slot coverage. Handles and locators must remain intact so duplicate labels, missing records and vendor naming can be reconciled against the platform topology.
